defaults.rationale: Paired on/off low-speed development only; no safety limit changes or successful-seed selection.

parameters.name: phase5_isolation_stride
parameters.rationale: Reconstruct sensor histories every frame, sample same-own-memory counterfactual decisions every10 and final frame.

parameters.name: phase5_random_seeds
parameters.rationale: Two fixed seeds per3/6/12 vehicles, all retained.

parameters.name: phase5_min_initial_same_lane_center_gap_m
parameters.rationale: Continuous rejection sampling initial spacing only; no global lattice.
